goal: Nine external agents - including YC companies Nia (S24), Airweave (X25), Vellum (W23), Hyperspell (F25), and LiteLLM (W23) - negotiate the build of Arbor's agent observability stack: data sync, docs grounding, library versions, workflow orchestration, durable memory, model gateway, frontend, and engineering. Each agent proposes its slice priced at its true delivery cost; no budget ceiling is disclosed.
